newFeatures.new:next-spell-gains-keyword: A one-shot effect that gives the controller's next matching spell this turn a keyword (storm, cascade, …) as it's cast — 'the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn has storm'.

bugs.what: A mass destroy that includes the would-die-exile-instead permanent itself moves the victims one by one, so creatures moved after it go to the graveyard (repro: Vren + opponent's Grizzly Bears, destroy-all creatures → Bears in graveyard; ruling says exile).
A commander whose owner sends it to the command zone never dies, so its own dies trigger is lost (repro: isCommander Child of Alara destroyed → command zone, other nonland permanents survive).

whyCannotActivateAbility (game.ts ~6872) drops the source from the target options when an ability has otherOnly, though otherOnly is meant only for the sacrifice cost; if Dina's only other creature can't be targeted (shroud), activation is refused where the real card may target Dina herself. The actual offer and dispatch still allow Dina as a target.

Negative amounts aren't clamped to 0 (rule 107.1b): powerOf a sacrificed creature with negative last-known power makes gain-life lose life and add-counter add a negative count. Engine-wide — Greater Good and Altar of Dementia read the same amount.

With this batch's three cards added, `random-demo.mjs --games 8 --players 4` times out on seed 4 (decks Leonardo, the Balance / Ognis / Doran / Dogmeat, none from C2). Authority of the Consuls triggers once per token as an opponent's Scute Swarm stack doubles, so 300+ gain-life triggers pile onto the stack each time. A watcher's per-entering-creature trigger over a token stack isn't count-scaled or batched. Passes on main only because the new cards shift the fuzzer's deck windows.
